title: 2021 AMC 12A Problem 8
statement: A sequence of numbers is defined by \(D_0 = 0,\) \(D_1 = 0,\) \(D_2 = 1,\) and \(D_n = D_{n-1} + D_{n-3}\) for \(n \ge 3.\) What are the parities (evenness or oddness) of the triple of numbers \((D_{2021}, D_{2022}, D_{2023}),\) where \(E\) denotes even and \(O\) denotes odd?

solutions.text:
Working modulo \(2,\) the terms \(D_0, D_1, D_2, \ldots\) have parities \(E,\) \(E,\) \(O,\) \(O,\) \(O,\) \(E,\) \(O,\) \(E,\) \(E,\) \(O,\) \(O,\) \(O,\) \(E,\) \(O, \ldots\) which repeat with period \(7\) starting from \(D_0\) (indeed \(D_7, D_8, D_9\) have the same parities \(E, E, O\) as \(D_0, D_1, D_2\)).

Since \(2021 \equiv 5,\) \(2022 \equiv 6,\) and \(2023 \equiv 0 \pmod 7,\) the parities match those of \(D_5, D_6, D_0,\) namely \(E, O, E.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Only parities matter, so compute the sequence with each term as \(E\) or \(O\) using \(O+O=E\)
The parity sequence repeats with period \(7;\) reduce \(2021, 2022, 2023\) modulo \(7\)
